title: Verify the trope surveys against their sources
description: Check every cited URL in the US and global surveys; keep only supported entries; record removals.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Feature: Trope surveys are verified against their sources

Scenario: Only supported entries remain in the survey
  Given the US and global trope surveys with every entry citing a source URL
  When I check every cited URL against the claimed trope
  Then unsupported entries are removed and docs/tropes-survey.md records each removal with its reason

right_now_summary: The US and global trope surveys are checked against their sources, with unsupported entries removed and logged.
